clauses.reason: Section 1(a)(i) prohibits new investment in the Russian Federation by a United States person wherever located. No held instrument revokes, supersedes, amends or limits this clause. The national emergency under which it acts (declared in Executive Order 14024) was continued by the Federal Register notices of April 13, 2022, April 7, 2023, April 9, 2024, April 10, 2025 and March 24, 2026; the last, dated March 24, 2026 (91 FR 15515), continues it beyond April 15, 2026 for 1 year, which covers 2026-10-14. Executive Order 14114 of December 22, 2023 recites Executive Order 14071 among the steps relying on that emergency and does not revoke or amend it. The U.S. Code note on Pub. L. 118-50, div. G, sec. 1 (50 U.S.C. 1701 note) names Executive Order 14071 as a sanctions authority. The clause was therefore operative on 2026-10-14.
